newsitem.title: LATVIA: Unibanka most active again on Latvia bourse.
newsitem.headline: Unibanka most active again on Latvia bourse.

text.p: Leading bank Unibanka was again the most active stock on the Latvian bourse on Wednesday and its shares climbed slightly higher.
Overall market turnover was 71,830 lats of which Unibanka accounted for 37,611 lats. It rose to 2.35 lats from 2.30 lats.
Riga Transport Fleet ended its recent run of being unchanged at stock market sessions and dipped by one santime to 99 on low trade of 5,247 lats.
The most active share on the secondary market was the Kaija fish cannery which turned over 11,933 lats and was stable at 1.21 lats.
Other active secondary market shares included the Daugavpils chain firm on turnover of 7,398 lats as it rose to 1.14 lats from 1.13 lats.
The Riga Yeast factory saw activity of 5,070 lats and dipped to 1.95 lats from 1.96 and the Lode Brick company traded 2,415 lats and was stable at 1.05 lats.
